## About
Ed's Rapid Sticker, formerly Smog Plus, is a full service shop for foreign and domestic cars in the Spring and Humble area. We specialize in air conditioning, wheel alignments and state inspection stickers, and we handle the everyday repairs and maintenance in between.
Our main focus is personal customer service. We keep our overhead low so we can do quality work at rates that make sense. Customers have rated us 4.3 from 94 Google reviews, and a lot of them have been bringing their cars to Ed for a long time.

## Services
- State inspection stickers: Texas state inspections and emissions testing, the work we're named for.
- Air conditioning: A/C work for foreign and domestic cars, one of our specialties.
- Wheel alignments: Another of our specialties, for foreign and domestic cars.
- Complete brake service: Brake inspection and repair.
- Tune ups and oil changes: Routine maintenance to keep your car running right.
- Shocks, struts and ball joints: Suspension work for a smoother ride.
- Belts, hoses and radiators: Cooling system and belt repairs.
- Mufflers and exhaust systems: Exhaust repair and replacement.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open 8 AM to 5 PM, Monday through Friday. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. We have an early bird key drop for after hours drop off.

Q: Do you give free repair estimates?
A: Yes. Call us for a free repair estimate and compare our prices.

Q: Do you honor extended warranties?
A: Yes, we honor extended warranties.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: We welcome Master Card and Visa. Sorry, we don't take checks.

Q: Do you offer towing?
A: Yes. We tow within 5 miles for $60.00.

Q: Where exactly are you?
A: We're on Cypresswood Drive, two blocks north of F.M. 1960 Road West in the Spring and Humble area.
